what: The ARC-AGI-3 metric is a 1-to-2-event statistic. Same code, same seed, two action budgets.
mechanism: EnvironmentScoreCalculator.add_level appends a hard 0.0 for every UNCOMPLETED level, and to_score divides sum(level_scores) by len(level_scores) -- the TOTAL level count. A game's score is therefore (a few small numbers) / (its total level count), then averaged over games.

identity.note: The entire difference between the two configurations is one level cleared in one game (r11l).

leaderboard_context.caveat: The leaderboard is computed on approximately 50% of the test data, so a public half containing none of the 1-2 cleared levels scores ~0.
